corpus.selection: sha absent from every existing receipt and corpus file; one source and one test file; oracle executes

declared_before_the_run.N1: at least one fresh real commit is VERIFIED by substituting a name that existed in the executed frame
declared_before_the_run.N2: the substituted name is not the name at the site and the whole suite stays green
declared_before_the_run.N3: the generator reads no commit diff and no human edit before the verdict
declared_before_the_run.N4: zero parameters stored, zero model calls, zero network calls
declared_before_the_run.N5: every counted row has a real failing test and a whole-file execution

what_this_is_not: not a benchmark: real commits, producer-run, no independent verifier
not general SWE: single identifier substitution on an executed line
not trained: the substitutions are computed from the frame and the test's own strings
